title: All the same
titleEn: Using All the same as a concessive connector

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Contrasting fact or difficulty. All the same, + complete sentence

formulas.formula: Contrasting fact or difficulty. All the same, + complete sentence

example: The risks were obvious. All the same, they chose to move forward.
exampleZh: 風險很明顯。儘管如此，他們仍選擇繼續前進。

examples.en: The risks were obvious. All the same, they chose to move forward.
examples.zh: 風險很明顯。儘管如此，他們仍選擇繼續前進。
examples.highlight: The risks were obvious. All the same, they chose to move forward.

rules.zh: All the same 表示「儘管如此」 它表示前面的情況可能令人預期另一個結果，但後面的事情仍然發生。 （旅程令人疲倦。儘管如此，我們仍很享受。）
rules.en: All the same means “nevertheless” or “despite that”. It shows that an earlier situation might lead us to expect a different result, yet the later event still happens. For example: The journey was tiring. All the same, we enjoyed it.
examples: The journey was tiring. All the same, we enjoyed it.

rules.zh: 前面通常要有一個完整意思 All the same 需要回應前面提及的困難、缺點、反對理由或相反事實，不能在沒有上文的情況下 隨意使用。
rules.en: All the same normally refers back to a complete preceding idea. It must respond to an earlier difficulty, drawback, objection or contrary fact; do not use it without relevant context.

rules.zh: 本課使用以下標點格式 All 使用大寫。 same 後面加逗號。 本課統一在 All the same 前使用句號。
rules.en: Use the punctuation format taught in this lesson: capitalise All, place a comma after same, and put a full stop before All the same.
examples: All
same

rules.en: Follow it with a complete sentence.
examples: All the same, we decided to continue.
All the same, the difficult situation.

rules.zh: 本課不教授另一個意思 在以下句子中，all the same 表示「對我來說沒有分別」，不是「儘管如此」。 （對我來說都一樣。） 這個意思不包括在本練習內。 與近似句型的分別 意思：儘管如此／即便如此 它連接兩個意思相反或結果出乎預期的句子。 （風險很明顯。儘管如此，他們仍繼續前進。） 重點：前面的困難沒有阻止後面的事情發生。 意思：更加／反而更…… 它不是表示「儘管如此」，而是加強形容詞或副詞的程度。 （這項任務很困難，但這反而令最後的成功更有意義。） 例如： 重點：前面的情況令某種程度變得更高。 意思：更加有理由做……／更應該做…… 它表示前面的情況提供了一個更強的行動理由。 （如果犯錯代價高昂，那就更有理由做好準備。） 重點：前面的情況增加了做某事的理由。 三者的核心分別 All the same：困難存在，事情仍然發生。 All the more + adjective/adverb：某種程度反而增加。 All the more reason to + verb：做某事的理由反而更強。
rules.en: This lesson does not teach the other meaning of all the same. In It is all the same to me, the phrase means “it makes no difference to me”, not “nevertheless”; that meaning is outside this exercise. Also distinguish three similar structures. All the same means “nevertheless” or “even so” and links ideas with an unexpected contrast: The risks were obvious. All the same, they moved forward. The point is that the difficulty did not prevent the later event. All the more + adjective/adverb means that a degree increases; it does not mean “nevertheless”: The task was difficult, but that made the final success all the more meaningful. The point is that a quality becomes stronger. All the more reason to + verb means that an earlier situation provides a stronger reason to act: If mistakes are costly, that is all the more reason to prepare well. The core distinction is: All the same—a difficulty exists but something still happens; all the more + adjective/adverb—a degree increases; all the more reason to + verb—the reason for an action becomes stronger.
examples: It is all the same to me.
The risks were obvious. All the same, they moved forward.
B. All the more + adjective / adverb
The task was difficult, but that made the final success all the more meaningful.
all the more + adjective / adverb
all the more important
all the more impressive
all the more carefully
C. All the more reason to + verb
If mistakes are costly, that is all the more reason to prepare well.
That is all the more reason to + base verb.
All the same：

benefits.zh: 清楚表達「有困難，仍然繼續」 這個句型能讓讀者立即看出，前面的問題並沒有阻止後面的行動或結果。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that an action or result continues despite an earlier difficulty.

benefits.zh: 讓兩個意思之間的關係更清楚 它不只是列出兩件事，而是清楚顯示第二件事在第一個不利情況下仍然發生。
benefits.en: It makes the relationship between two ideas clear by showing that the second still happens under the first unfavourable condition.

benefits.zh: 幫助你承認問題後再表達立場 在討論、作文或工作場合中，你可以先承認風險或缺點，再說明自己的決定。 （這個計劃成本高昂。儘管如此，它仍可能值得考慮。）
benefits.en: It helps you acknowledge a problem before stating your position. In a discussion, essay or workplace context, you can first recognise a risk or drawback and then explain your decision: The plan is expensive. All the same, it may be worth considering.
examples: The plan is expensive. All the same, it may be worth considering.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 but 或 however 學生經常重複使用 but。使用 All the same 可以增加句式變化，令說話和寫作不那麼單調。
benefits.en: It avoids repeatedly using but or however and gives speaking and writing more sentence variety.
examples: The hotel was expensive, but we stayed there.
The hotel was expensive. All the same, we stayed there.

benefits.zh: 令語氣顯得平衡而有分寸 它能表示你已經考慮過反面情況，而不是忽略問題後直接作出結論。
benefits.en: It creates a balanced, measured tone by showing that you considered the opposing fact before reaching a conclusion.
